RIVERA Punong Barangay Barangay Langgam, City of San Pedro Province of Laguna Dear PB Rivera: This has reference to your request for legal opinion relative to some issues and concems you are confronting as Punong Barangay. As background, you mentioned that on May 20, 2024, you sent a letter to DILG City Director Lenie Bautista requesting her assistance during Sangguniang Barangay sessions due to ongoing disrespect from certain Sangguniang Bayan members. However, you stated that City Director Bautista took no action to address the issue. You also stated that on June 11, 2024, members of the Sangguniang Barangay filed a case against you before the Sangguniang Panlungsod of San Pedro City. According to you, the Sangguniang Panlungsod fast-tracked the proceedings, resulting in your preventive suspension being enforced through a mere memorandum—issued not by the Mayor but solely by the City Administrator, Atty. Henry Salazar, without the Mayor's signature. You further stated that the Sangguniang Panlungsod has a pattern of suspending Punong Barangays who are not allied with the incumbent mayor, particularly before scheduled ABC elections. Finally, you said Based on the foregoing, you are requesting the Department to take the following actions: I. To issue an opinion on the legality of the action of the City Administrator in implementing the preventive suspension recommended by the Sangguniang Panlungsod, even without the signature of the City Mayor; 2. To investigate the actions and inaction of City Director Lenie M. Bautista towards the issues involved in our Barangay, and place her under preventive suspension; 3. To investigate the legality of the actions of the Sangguniang Panlungsod "Matino, Mahusay at Maaasahan" Trunkline No.: 8876-34-54

towards multiple Barangay Officials which tantamount to abuse of authority in relation to the exercise of said power being used arbitrarily and without regard to the law, For the first concern, the Department cannot render an opinion on presumptively valid acts, such as those undertaken by the Sangguniang Panlungsod, pursuant to DILG Memorandum Circular No. 2010-021, As such, only a competent court has the authority to determine the legality of the City Administrator's implementation of your preventive suspension. If you believe due process was not observed, you may seek judicial intervention to question the validity of the suspension. For the second request, we acknowledge your concern regarding the alleged inaction of City Director Lenie M. Bautista. The matter has been endorsed to DILG Region IV-A for appropriate investigation and action, as they have jurisdiction over the concemed official. As regards the third concern, the DILG exercises general supervisory functjons over LGUs but does not have the power to discipline elective local officials. Under the law, the Sangguniang Panlalawigan is the proper body to investigate and impose disciplinary actions on members of the Sangguniang Panlungsod. If you believe there is a pattem of politically motivated suspensions, we recommend seeking legal recourse before the appropriate tribunal. We trust this clarifies your concems. This opinion is based solely on the facts you provided and does not preclude differing interpretations by competent authorities or courts. Very truly yours, RO S RAPH .
